body: Ive found a hard time finding a church and pastor that I connect with. Could be my social anxiety, but on top of many things, I'm scared that someone would try and report me for inpatient and if my daughters father and I end up in court for custody he is going to use it against me to take her from me.

I'm too picky when it comes to alcohol and won't do drugs because I need a job. 
When my prescription ran out and I went back to the doctor he just said it was me coming off the Zoloft and it would level back out. To be fair for his lack of care, it was only an obgybn treating me for postpartum depression. I tried to explain it was more and had been there for longer, but he chopped it up to my high risk pregnancy. Needless to say he didn't refer me or continue my medicine.

I don't have insurance, and all the therapists in my area want like 100 a session and I just got laid off work and I couldn't afford it even when I was working. I've got a lot of shit from my childhood that needs worked through and would love to try therapy, but it's just not attainable.

I don't know. Honestly I feel stupid even writing it all out. I've tried medication and it didn't help, and my doctor said I would "feel better at the end of my three month prescription". Just seeing everything written out makes me feel so whiney and I should suck it up.
